name: wealthynest-post-deploy-smoke
description: Read-only, DB-free browser smoke checks run against the live production URLs right after a backend deploy. Deliberately separate from ../../playwright (the app's own E2E suite) - that suite's global-setup needs direct Postgres access to verify a test user's email, and production RDS sits in a private-isolated subnet with no internet route at all, so no security-group rule could make it reachable from a GitHub-hosted runner even temporarily.
